observations: White Xbox One S console with a distinctive silver dot-matrix pattern on the front and sides.
A black wireless controller is resting on top of the console.
The console has a matte finish and is sitting on a wooden table.
The Xbox logo is visible on the top right of the console in photo 0.
The console has a single disc slot on the front left side.
The console appears to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible cracks or deep scratches.

claims.evidence: The console design in photos 0, 1, and 2 matches the Xbox One S model.
The storage capacity is not visible on the front of the console.
A black controller is visible on top of the console in photos 0 and 1.
No game discs or cases are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear picture on a TV.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be smaller than 1TB or the HDD may be failing.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen in the console's system menu.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the Xbox Live service.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Status' screen showing a connected account.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen in the console settings to confirm the 1TB capacity.
Video of the console booting up and connecting to a TV.
Photo of the 'System Status' screen to check for a banned account.
Photo of the console's rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Xbox One S. It can be priced at its worst case (non-working, 500GB) until proof of functionality and storage capacity is provided.
